en.title: Count Free Roof-Painting Options from Generated Side Lengths
en.description:
Generate n side lengths: s[0]=seed, s[i]=s[i−1]+1+((k*s[i−1]+b) mod m). Both the length and the width are chosen from these side lengths, and a roof with area≤area can be painted for free. Count the ordered (length, width) combinations: swapping length and width gives a different option, and a square is counted once.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and numeric ranges missing from the original text are explicitly marked as this site's additions.
en.input: One line: seed n k b m area. 1≤n≤6000000; 1≤seed,k,b,m≤10⁹, 1≤area≤10¹⁸; every generated s[i] is guaranteed to be in 1..10⁹ as well. The original upper bound of 6,000,000 for n is not reduced; use exact integer comparisons.
en.output: Output the single integer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 5; 1; 1. The examples were checked by independent enumeration, state search, or direct simulation.
hints: Each side length is at least 1 greater than the previous one, so the sequence is already strictly increasing. Store it in a compact unsigned 32-bit array and move a right pointer leftward from the end; for each left side length, add the number of right side lengths whose area qualifies.
